reason: My workshop gives me a price on WhatsApp in a minute and my cousin had his bumper done there, so I already know who to trust. A new app with partners only just being added in Riyadh and Cairo is a stranger I would have to pay money into.
objection: I don't know these partners. Verified ID and registration sound good, but I still wouldn't know if the guy actually does the job well on an M4 until I see the car after.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or family member who I trust has used ArmorHub for the same job and their car came out well.
